description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class `BaseModuleContextSensitiveTest` for use with JUnit 5 in the OpenMRS module testing framework. It configures context loading via Spring annotations to include module-specific application contexts.

classes.name: BaseModuleContextSensitiveTest
classes.description: An abstract class used as a base for module tests that require a Spring application context. It loads specific context configuration files pertinent to OpenMRS modules.

methods.name: BaseModuleContextSensitiveTest
methods.description: Default constructor inheriting from its superclass. Since the class is abstract, it is meant to be subclassed for specific tests.
